blocks.text: There is a certain rhythm to a perfect mall day. It ideally begins with a good cup of coffee, finds its stride over a satisfying lunch, takes a sweet detour in the afternoon, and eventually brings everyone together around the dinner table. Somewhere between browsing your favorite stores and catching up with friends, a quick stop for a bite turns into a meal worth lingering over. At SM Megamall, dining can be the main event just as easily as it can be a welcome break from a day of shopping. With an array of participating restaurants to choose from, there is […]...
